sloka: ततस्तांस्त्रीन् हतान् ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना ।अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम् ।। ५.४६.३१।।।।
transliteration: tatastāṁstrīn hatān jñātvā vānareṇa tarasvinā ।abhipede mahāvegaḥ prasahya praghaso harim ।। 5.46.31।।।।

translations.english: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war
